prose: Cairn is Norforge's transparency project publishing 'open windows' into AI-driven cyber operations - and the excerpted material shows what one looks like from the inside: an agent tasking document aimed at confirmed real e-commerce sites in four countries (US/CA/JP/AU) with 200K-1.5M traffic, pre-verified with Playwright for order placement. The objective listed is unauthenticated RCE via a familiar menu - SQL injection, file-upload webshells, deserialization, SSTI, SSRF - with priorities on login SQLi, unauthenticated endpoints and account takeover. The payload spec is an uploader shell, explicitly not a command-executing webshell, and the environment is a Kali container. It documents, in the operator's own format, how the $5,000-token campaigns are actually tasked.
highlights: Cairn publishes inside looks at AI-driven cyber operations
Shown tasking targets real e-commerce sites in US/CA/JP/AU, 200K-1.5M traffic
Objective: unauthenticated RCE via SQLi, uploads, deserialization, SSTI, SSRF
Payload: an uploader shell, explicitly not a command-executing webshell
Environment: a Kali container; targets pre-verified with Playwright
Concrete evidence of how low-cost agentic intrusion campaigns are specified
